build.server: socialCalc youtubeChannel reads the channel totals from the first item that carries a subscriber count (top level or aboutChannelInfo, numbers or '8.1K'), and answers empty when none does; socialMeasure youtubeRun takes the snapshot from whichever tab answer carries totals, the one-item channel read tries the Shorts tab after an empty Videos tab, and an empty read writes no snapshot (the last good one stays).
build.diagnosis: From the code and the 11 Sep probe fixtures: the Videos tab of a shorts-only channel answers with an error item (as the Streams tab does for a channel with no streams); youtubeChannel treated that as 'empty, no error', and youtubeRun's `good = !chV.error ? chV : …` chose it over the Shorts answer that carried the totals. A read of the live rows for the creator in the screenshot was attempted and blocked by the session's production-read permission; not needed — the screenshot matches the fault exactly (totals blank, shorts measured, long '—' because she has no long videos).
build.red_first: run on the code as it was, three new checks failed exactly as the fault describes: full run on a shorts-only channel stored subscribers null / channel_id null; a totals-less profile run wrote a second blank snapshot and blanked the creator's row; the stripped-first calculator case gave null.
build.backend_new_tests: item3b-pipeline: 2 new (shorts-only full run + following profile run keeps 52000 with two Apify calls; totals-less profile run keeps the last snapshot); item3b-calculators: 1 new (first-item-with-totals, nested, '8.1K', no-videos error). 3/3 passing after the fix; the pre-existing item 3b tests unchanged in outcome.
